Image 1 — the KALDR bottle. Preserve the smoked charcoal glass, bevelled edges, pale blue liquid, brushed gunmetal cap and the etched silver KALDR mark exactly.
Image 2 — the closing brand lockup. Preserve the letterforms, tracking, silver finish and the COLD KEEPS line exactly. It appears only in the final shot, alone on black.
Image 3 — the location, palette, cloud, surf and film texture for the whole film.
Image 4 — a three panel character sheet of the woman. Use it only to match her face, hair, frost detail and black greatcoat. Do not reproduce the sheet's panel layout, its grey backdrop or its flat studio lighting. She must appear as a single person inside the Image 3 environment, lit by that location.
Audio 1 — the voice for the woman's spoken line. Match its timbre, pitch, accent, breathiness and pacing exactly. Use it only for her voice, not as background audio or ambience.

Premium luxury fragrance brand film. Photoreal 35mm anamorphic, high contrast, fine grain, cold specular highlights, deep crushed blacks. Palette strictly black sand, gunmetal, glacial blue and silver, with no warm tones anywhere. Setting: a black volcanic beach on a northern coast at blue hour under heavy storm cloud. Tone: severe, violent, expensive. This is a fast, aggressive fashion edit, not a calm product film. Never slow, never ceremonial, never a slideshow of pretty holds.

[0-1.5s] Cold open, no establishing shot. Camera at water level, lens half submerged, [Static shot]. A sheet of freezing surf races straight at the lens. Her boots stride hard into frame through the water, coat hem whipping. HARD CUT.

[1.5-2.6s] Extreme macro insert. Frost crystals race across black glass and flood the etched KALDR mark with rime, filling the letters. HARD CUT.

[2.6-4.2s] Behind her, low and close, [Tracking shot] pushing fast. She walks straight into an oncoming wave that towers over her, coat streaming sideways, never breaking stride. HARD CUT.

[4.2-5.4s] Reverse, low angle from the water. The wave collapses over her. Camera [Shake] on the impact. Cut on the peak of the white spray. HARD CUT.

[5.4-9s] SLOW MOTION. The wave freezes solid around her mid collapse. She stands inside a shell of blue black ice, the spray suspended in the air as a thousand hanging shards, her coat frozen mid snap, her face calm and unbothered. Camera [Tracking shot] orbits right through the suspended shards, holding her at centre. This is the hero image of the film.

[9-9.8s] Snap back to real time. The ice shell detonates outward. Camera [Pull out] fast and hard through the exploding shards. HARD CUT.

[9.8-12.6s] Tight close up, [Push in]. She walks out of the collapsing ice straight at the lens, ice water running off her coat, looking directly into camera. She says quietly: "I was never meant to melt." She holds the look for a beat after the line. HARD CUT.

[12.6-13.8s] The bottle alone, upright on wet black sand, shot low and close on a macro lens. Frost blooms outward from its base toward the lens. No text of any kind in this shot. HARD CUT.

[13.8-15s] Pure black frame. The brand lockup from Image 2 appears alone, centred, exactly as in the reference. The wordmark KALDR emerges from darkness at low opacity, letter spacing opening over 0.4 seconds into sharp focus with a faint edge glow, and the line COLD KEEPS sits smaller beneath it. Nothing else is in this frame. Critical: the bottle, the woman, the beach and the wordmark must never share a frame. The lockup must never overlap or be occluded by the bottle, and the etched mark on the glass must never appear in the same shot as the lockup. Hold the lockup to the end.

Dialogue and lip sync: only one line is spoken, in the shot beginning at 9.8 seconds: "I was never meant to melt." Match the voice in Audio 1 exactly, including its timbre, breathiness, pacing and the way the sentence lands without rising at the end. Do not substitute a different voice, do not add reverb or processing that changes its character. Her lip movement must match the words frame accurately and stop when the line ends. Her breath fogs on the words. Do not repeat the line and do not add any other spoken words anywhere in the film.

@ Image1 is the sole authority for the PROOF logo: the roundel of five concentric rings

[GOAL]
A 15-second vertical 9:16 social launch commercial for PROOF, a dawn bakery delivery
service. Fast-cut, caption-led, designed to be understood with the sound off. Photoreal
documentary commercial cinematography on 35mm, fine grain, shallow depth of field,
handheld with restrained movement.

[THE LIGHT IS THE CLOCK]
The film brightens continuously from beginning to end. It opens in near-darkness lit by
a single work lamp and finishes in full warm golden sunrise. Every shot is measurably
lighter than the one before it. This progression must be unbroken.

[CAPTION CHIPS]
Throughout, a single caption chip sits in the lower third, horizontally centred, in the
same position in every shot. It is a rounded rectangle in burnt ochre with warm cream
text, two lines: a lighter-weight top line and a bold bottom line. The chip changes
content on the cuts listed below and never moves, resizes or animates. Type must be
crisp and correctly spelled.

[SEQUENCE — cut on every timing, eight cuts]
0-1.9s    HERO. Interior of a small bakery at night, lit by one overhead work lamp.
          A baker's hands turn a large mass of wet dough on a floured steel bench.
          Everything else in the room is black.
          CHIP: "04:12" / "someone is already awake"
1.9-3.6s  INSERT. Extreme close-up, a handful of flour thrown across the bench, dust
          catching the single lamp.
          CHIP unchanged.
3.6-5.4s  HERO. A row of round dough balls resting in floured proving baskets on a rack.
          Slightly warmer, slightly brighter. One dough is visibly swollen and domed.
          CHIP: "05:30" / "it's proving"
5.4-7.1s  INSERT. An oven door swings open and a wall of steam rolls out toward camera,
          lit warm from inside.
          CHIP unchanged.
7.1-8.9s  HERO. A dark-crusted round sourdough loaf lands on a cooling rack. Hold on it.
          The crust is visibly crackling and ticking as it cools.
          CHIP: "06:15" / "it's out of the oven"
8.9-10.6s INSERT. The loaf is slid into the kraft PROOF bag from @ Image2, the top folded
          over once and taped. The ochre roundel and wordmark clearly readable.
          CHIP unchanged.
10.6-12.3s HERO. The courier from @ Image3 rides away down an empty terraced street in
          low golden sunrise, satchel on their back, PROOF mark readable, streetlights
          switching off behind them.
          CHIP: "06:52" / "it's moving"
12.3-13.6s INSERT. The kraft bag set down on a stone doorstep in full golden light,
          exactly as in @ Image2. A hand withdraws from frame. Steam rises from the fold.
          CHIP: "07:04" / "it's at your door"
13.6-15s  END FRAME. Cut to a clean flat warm cream background. The PROOF concentric
          ring mark and wordmark from @ Image1 sit centred, still, in burnt ochre and
          dark rye brown. Beneath them, small, in dark rye brown: "now delivering".
          CHIP for the final beat only: "bread younger than your alarm", single bold
          line, centred. Absolutely no motion on this frame — it is a still card.

[COLOUR]
Burnt ochre is a physical object in the world before it is ever an interface colour —
it is printed ink on the kraft bag and on the canvas satchel, lit by real light. The
caption chip is the only ochre graphic element. Palette: warm cream, kraft brown, burnt
ochre, dark rye brown, one cool blue-grey in the pre-dawn shadows.

3.6-7.1s  Quieter still. A rack wheeled a short distance. The heavy clunk of an oven
          latch and a deep roll of escaping steam.
7.1-8.9s  THIS IS THE MOMENT THE WHOLE FILM IS BUILT AROUND. A loaf on a wire rack, its

          Bring the rest of the mix down under it.
8.9-12.3s Kraft paper crumpling and folding, tape torn. Then outdoors: a freewheel
          ticking, tyres on wet tarmac, one blackbird, distant early traffic.
12.3-15s  The bag setting down on stone. Footsteps leaving. Birdsong. Then near silence
          under the end card, with one last faint crust tick.
No music, no voiceover, no narration, no dialogue, no whoosh transitions, no sound
effects that are not physically present in the scene.

[NEGATIVE]
No text of any kind other than the caption chips, the PROOF wordmark, and "now
delivering". No other logos, no brand names, no shop signage, no readable street signs,
no house numbers, no phone screens, no app interfaces, no price, no website, no social

spelling of the wordmark. No music. No people speaking. No faces held in close-up for
longer than one second — this is about the bread, not a character. No slow motion, no

ボールが床に接触するタイミング、手から手へ移る瞬間、踏み切り、ジャンプ、リングへの到達、ダンク、着地を、力強いヒップホップまたはエレクトロニック・ミュージックのキック、スネア、ベースに正確にシンクロさせる。ボールが床に当たるたびに円形の波紋が広がり、クロスオーバーに合わせて鋭いラインが左右へ走り、方向転換すると背景の色面が瞬時に切り替わる。ダンクの瞬間には、すべてのシェイプとタイポグラフィーがビートに合わせて大きく反応する。

背景では、長方形、円、三角形、太いライン、グリッド、コートラインなどのシェイプが、画面の上下左右や奥行き方向から勢いよくスライドインし、次のビートでスライドアウトする。複数のシェイプが異なる方向から重なり合い、分割、回転、拡大、縮小を繰り返しながら、リズミカルに画面構成を作り替えていく。ただし、シェイプで人物、ボール、リングを完全に隠さず、プレーの流れが常に明確に見えるようにする。

背景には「BASKETBALL」「DRIBBLE」「DUNK」という単語を、正確なスペルの大文字でキネティック・タイポグラフィーとして登場させる。文字は一度表示されて終わるのではなく、登場後も音楽のビートに合わせて脈打つように拡大・縮小を繰り返し、前後左右への3D回転、奥行き方向への移動、軽い伸縮、色の切り替えを続ける。

3D回転した文字は再び正面を向き、各単語が明確に読める瞬間を必ず作る。文字の欠落、重複、誤字、別の文字への変化は起こさず、「BASKETBALL」「DRIBBLE」「DUNK」以外の文字は表示しない。タイポグラフィーは人物とボールの背後や周囲で動かし、プレーを妨げない背景のグラフィック要素として使用する。

カメラは基本的に人物の全身とボールを正面から捉えながら、音楽の強いビートに合わせてアングルを大胆に切り替える。正面からの構図に加えて、人物を斜め上から見下ろす俯瞰ショットと、斜め下から見上げる力強いローアングルショットを入れる。

俯瞰ショットでは、コート上を動く足、ドリブルの軌道、床面を流れるシェイプやタイポグラフィーを印象的に見せる。ローアングルショットでは、黒いボールが床へ迫って跳ね返る瞬間、主人公の鋭い方向転換、ゴールへ向かう加速、踏み切りからダンクまでの高さと迫力を強調する。さらに、真横からの高速追従、短いズームインとズームアウト、左右へのスライド、リング付近から人物を見下ろす構図、ダンクする主人公を斜め下から捉える構図を加える。

カットが切り替わっても、人物の動作、進行方向、ボールの位置、ドリブルのリズムを途切れさせず、同じ人物による一続きのプレーとして自然につなげる。アングルが変わっても、同一人物、同一の黒いボール、同一のコートとゴールを維持する。

ボールは映像全体を通して必ず1個だけにする。ボールの大きさと完全な球形を維持し、複製、変形、消失、瞬間移動、色の変化を発生させない。手、床、リングとの接触を物理的に正しく表現し、ボールが手や床をすり抜けないようにする。黒いボールが黒い身体と重なる場面でも、腕の位置と背景の色によって、ボールの丸い輪郭を判別できるようにする。

人物の形状、体格、手足の本数を15秒間一貫させ、手足の変形、身体の分裂、不自然な残像を発生させない。リング、バックボード、ネットもシンプルな形状を維持し、ダンクの前後で位置や大きさを変化させない。

大胆でありながら統一感のある配色、シャープなグラフィック、強いコントラスト、正確なビートシンクによって、とにかくカッコよく、スタイリッシュで、ファッション性の高い映像に仕上げる。終盤に向けてドリブル、カメラワーク、シェイプ、タイポグラフィーの動きを徐々に高密度にし、最後の強いビートでワンハンドダンクを決める。

ダンク後は大げさに喜んだり決めポーズを取ったりしない。主人公は軽やかに着地し、リングを通過した黒いボールが床で一度だけ弾む。そのまま主人公が余裕のある動きでカメラの横を通り過ぎ、背景のグラフィックがビートの余韻に合わせて整列して、クールに終了する。SNSで拡散されそうな、センスが良く、中毒性があり、何度も見返したくなる高品質な映像にする。

prompts.text:
@[face ref] をNEONの顔、ピンクのボブヘア、黒い丸眼鏡の厳密な参照として使用します。
@[body ref] をNEONの体格、黒と赤のサイバーパンク衣装、装備、ブーツの厳密な参照として使用します。
@[audio ref] は映像のリズム、カットの強弱、主要な音楽アクセントの参照として使用します。

15秒のハイエンドなサイバーパンク・キャラクター紹介映像。
主役はNEONただ一人。
クールで知的、危険な雰囲気。動作は自信に満ち、抑制されている。

構成：

0–3秒：IDENTITY REVEAL
暗いネオン照明の空間。
ブーツ、赤いジャケットのディテール、眼鏡越しの目元を短いバーストカットで見せる。
最後に顔のクローズアップ。
カットを@[audio ref] の最初の強いアクセントに合わせる。

3–6秒：NEON ALLEY
雨に濡れた未来都市の路地。
NEONがゆっくりカメラ方向へ歩く。
ローアングル、横方向のトラッキング、濡れた路面に映る赤いネオン。
人物の動きよりもカメラワークを強調。

6–9秒：TECH UNDERGROUND
赤い警告灯が点滅する地下施設。
肩越しのショット、手袋と装備のクローズアップ、短いオービットショット。
NEONは静かに周囲を観察する。

9–12秒：MEGACITY ROOFTOP
巨大な未来都市を見下ろす夜の屋上。
風でピンクの髪とジャケットがわずかに揺れる。
ワイドショットからローアングルのヒーローフレームへ切り替える。

12–15秒：FINAL HERO REVEAL
赤とマゼンタの逆光。
カメラがNEONの周囲を短く回り込み、正面のミディアムクローズアップで止まる。
NEONが眼鏡越しにカメラを見る。
最後の音楽アクセントで力強い静止ヒーローフレーム。

編集：
合計12〜15ショット。
主要カットを@[audio ref] の強拍に合わせる。
環境変更は音楽フレーズの変化に合わせる。
細かい半拍すべてにカットを入れず、強いアクセントを優先する。

一貫性：
同じ顔、同じ髪型、同じ眼鏡、同じ体格、同じ衣装を全編で維持。
衣装の黒・赤・ゴールドの配色と装備位置を維持。
キャラクターは常に一人だけ。

禁止：
複数のNEON、分身、衣装変更、髪型変更、眼鏡の消失、
顔や身体のモーフィング、過剰なアクション、文字、ロゴ、字幕、UI、
キャラクターシート風レイアウト、分割画面、白背景。
-------------------------------------------------------

prompts.text: High-Speed K-pop Fashion MV, luxury fashion advertising + Material Kinetic Typography + Experimental Fashion Film + 3D Spatial Typography. Strictly use @Image1 as the only character reference throughout the entire film. Core visual concept: the same girl + giant physical English typography + constantly changing materials + typography moving through foreground, midground, and background around the character + high-speed camera movement + aggressive beat synchronization. This is NOT a conventional MV where a person simply stands in front of text. All typography must physically exist inside the same 3D space as the character. Typography can generate behind her, wrap around her shoulders into the foreground, then rush toward the camera; it can also fly in from the extreme foreground, pass along both sides of her body, and extend behind her. She can stand inside giant typography, walk between oversized letters, and become fully surrounded by text. All typography must have realistic occlusion, spatial depth, perspective, shadows, reflections, and interactive lighting.【CHARACTER LOCK｜HIGHEST PRIORITY】Strictly use the girl from @Image1. Maintain exactly the same face shape, facial-feature proportions, eye shape, eyebrow-to-eye proportions, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, body proportions, long straight black hair, and wispy bangs throughout the entire film. Young East Asian woman with a refined small oval face, dark eyes, petite natural nose, soft pink lips, and fair natural skin. Realistic skin texture, visible natural pores, realistic eyelashes, and individually defined black hair strands. Keep the clean K-pop makeup from the reference: natural base makeup, subtle pink eye makeup, thin eyeliner, natural lashes, and glossy pink lips. No face swapping, no Westernization, no facial drift, no face-shape changes, no age changes, no skin-tone changes, no hair-color changes, and never lose the bangs. Long black hair and wispy bangs are essential identity features and must remain consistent at all times.【WARDROBE】Use the original black edgy outfit from @Image1 as the visual foundation. Keep the overall palette BLACK + SILVER + DEEP RED. LOOK01: black fitted sleeveless crop top, black choker, silver necklace, silver earrings, silver mirrored low-rise mini skirt, black knee-high boots. LOOK02: black sleeveless top and choker, used for the Beauty Close-Up. LOOK03: black oversized cropped biker leather jacket + black tank top + black leather mini skirt + silver waist chain. LOOK04: deep burgundy modern reinterpreted short qipao, black piping, minimalist silver frog-button details, black knee-high boots. LOOK05: black cropped top + silver metallic mini skirt + black choker. LOOK06: black modern Chinese-inspired structured cropped top + black layered mini skirt + silver metallic accessories. LOOK07: distressed gray-blue denim cropped top + charcoal-black asymmetric low-rise mini skirt + silver waist chain. LOOK08: Final Dark Idol Look, black asymmetric cropped top + black ultra-short layered skirt + silver waist chain + black choker + black knee-high boots. Do not radically change the fashion identity between scenes; the character must remain visually unified throughout.【MUSIC】145–155 BPM, high-energy, sexy, edgy K-pop Fashion Beat. Music style: K-pop Girl Group + Electro Hip-Hop + Jersey Club + Fashion Runway Beat + Y2K Club Beat. Start immediately with an aggressive rhythm at 0 seconds, no slow intro. Strong Kick, Heavy Bass, crisp Snare, rapid Hi-Hat, Electronic Percussion, short Glitch Hits. Rhythm pattern similar to BOOM — CLAP — BOOM BOOM — CLAP. One obvious heavy beat every 1–1.5 seconds. Every outfit transition, typography appearance, text deformation, camera push, rotation, and material explosion must hit precisely on the beat. No lyrics, no vocals, no dialogue, no lip-syncing. Add material-specific sound effects including Smoke Whoosh, Neon Buzz, Metal Impact, Electric Crack, Plant Growth, Paper Flip, Fabric Whip, Wind Rush, and Bass Impact.【OVERALL COLOR PALETTE】Restrict colors to BLACK, WHITE, HOT PINK, DEEP PINK, BURGUNDY, SILVER. Black is the dominant spatial base, Hot Pink provides energy and highlights, silver defines metallic materials, white provides typography contrast, and burgundy adds a sophisticated fashion tone. No rainbow colors. No blue-purple cyberpunk palette. Overall aesthetic: K-pop Girl Group Comeback Concept Film × High Fashion Campaign × Experimental Typography MV.【SCENE 01｜0–1.6s｜FREE YOUR MIND｜SMOKE TYPOGRAPHY】Enter the climax immediately on the first beat. The girl wears a black fitted sleeveless crop top, black choker, silver necklace, silver mirrored mini skirt, and black knee-high boots. Full-body shot, standing exactly in the center of a vast black space with a subtly reflective floor. She faces the camera and suddenly reaches one hand toward the lens. BOOM! A massive burst of white + extremely pale pink smoke erupts from her palm. The smoke first forms a gigantic “FREE” behind her, approximately twice her height. On the next beat, smoke curls out from behind her left shoulder, passes into the space in front of her body, and forms “YOUR”. Finally, the smoke continues toward the camera and forms a gigantic “MIND” in the extreme foreground. Establish three clearly separated spatial layers: FREE in the background, character + YOUR in the midground, MIND in the foreground. She is genuinely surrounded by the typography. Smoke-letter edges continuously roll, expand, contract, and breathe. High-Speed Push-in from a frontal full-body view, rapidly approaching her, then fly directly into the interior of the “MIND” letters until the dark interior fills the entire frame for transition.【SCENE 02｜1.6–3.1s｜LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY｜NEON FACE CLOSE-UP】Instantly cut from darkness into an Extreme Beauty Close-Up. This is the most important face-locking shot in the entire film. Preserve exactly the same long black hair, wispy bangs, eyes, nose, lips, face shape, silver earrings, and choker from @Image1. Her face is slightly turned to the side. Her eyes first look to the right, then shift directly toward the camera. One finger rises from the bottom of the frame and a bright Hot Pink point of light appears at the fingertip. On the next beat, a pink Neon Line shoots rapidly from the fingertip. The neon first sweeps across the extreme foreground, passes beside her cheek, curves beneath her chin, crosses in front of her shoulder, then wraps behind her head to create a giant S-shaped 3D light trail. The trail gradually forms “LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY”. LIGHT occupies the foreground, YOUR wraps around her shoulder, OWN appears beside her, and WAY extends into the background. The neon realistically illuminates her eyes, cheekbones, nose bridge, and the edges of her black hair. The camera follows the neon trajectory at high speed, beginning at the front of her face, orbiting approximately 180 degrees around her, then rapidly Pull-out until the complete sentence becomes clearly readable once.【SCENE 03｜3.1–4.7s｜BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE｜LIQUID CHROME】BOOM! Instant wardrobe transition into the black biker look: black oversized cropped leather jacket, black tank top, black leather mini skirt, silver waist chain. Cut to Ultra-Wide + Extreme Low Angle. Large volumes of silver liquid metal rise from the floor like mercury, rapidly stretching upward into gigantic Chrome Typography two to three times taller than the character: “BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE”. The typography must not form a flat wall. It behaves like monumental typographic architecture. Some letters stand in front of her, others flank her left and right sides, and others rise behind her. She physically stands between the giant letters and takes one step forward through a gap between them. She raises her right hand; moving her palm left stretches the Chrome letters in the same direction, moving right makes them distort like liquid mercury. On the next beat she suddenly clenches her fist. CLAP! All letters instantly solidify, clearly displaying “BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE”. The camera races closely along the reflective Chrome letter surfaces, briefly revealing her reflection in the silver metal, then performs a high-speed Pull-out.【SCENE 04｜4.7–6.3s｜LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM｜BOTANICAL CIRCLE】Completely change composition to a 90° Top Shot. She now wears a deep burgundy modern reinterpreted short qipao, youthful and fitted, with black piping and minimalist silver frog-button details. Avoid traditional portrait-photography aesthetics. She is positioned exactly at the center of the frame, slightly crouching, with the tip of her right finger touching the ground. A tiny flower bud appears beneath her fingertip. On the next beat, vegetation suddenly grows outward at extreme speed. Black vines, deep burgundy petals, and small amounts of pink and white flowers spread 360 degrees around her. The plants do not form a background wall; they grow into a gigantic circular Typography Garden surrounding her. “LET YOUR” grows along her left side, “FUTURE” forms a massive semicircle above her, and “BLOOM” expands beneath her. Eventually “LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM” becomes a complete giant botanical typography ring with the girl perfectly centered inside it. BOOM! Every flower blooms simultaneously and a storm of petals flies directly toward the lens. The camera rapidly descends from the overhead position and dives through the flowers for transition.【SCENE 05｜6.3–7.9s｜POWER YOUR CHOICE｜ELECTRIC FOREGROUND】Hard Cut to a frontal centered composition. She returns to a black + silver outfit: black cropped top, silver metallic mini skirt, black choker. She stands relatively close to the camera and suddenly thrusts both hands toward the lens. Due to wide-angle perspective, both hands become large foreground elements, but anatomy must remain realistic and natural. A tiny Hot Pink electric spark appears between her fingertips. BOOM! Electricity violently erupts. Pink + white electrical currents first rush toward the camera and form a gigantic “POWER” between her and the lens. Then electricity passes between her hands and surrounds her torso to form “YOUR”. Finally, the current extends behind her and forms “CHOICE”. Create three clear spatial layers: POWER — foreground, YOUR — surrounding the character, CHOICE — background. Her face remains visible through gaps in the Electric Typography and her eyes must never be obstructed. High-speed Rack Focus sequence: fingertips → POWER → her eyes → YOUR → CHOICE → her eyes. Finally, a massive pink electrical bolt strikes directly toward the camera, creating a white flash transition.【SCENE 06｜7.9–9.5s｜STEP INTO YOUR STORY｜SHADOW TYPOGRAPHY】The white flash fades into an extremely wide side composition. She wears a black modern Chinese-inspired structured cropped top, black layered mini skirt, silver waist chain, and black knee-high boots. She is positioned on the left side of the frame, while a huge gray-white wall extends far toward the right. Strong directional side lighting creates an enormous elongated shadow across the wall and floor. She begins walking toward the right. On the first step, her shadow stretches and transforms into “STEP”. On the second step, STEP climbs from the floor onto the wall. Then “INTO” stretches away into the distance following spatial perspective. Finally, “YOUR STORY” suddenly expands from behind her into enormous Shadow Typography. She continues walking forward, physically passing between giant shadow letters S, T, O, R, Y. The camera performs high-speed Side Tracking parallel to her movement. At the end, she walks directly into the enormous black interior of “STORY”, and the shadow completely consumes the camera.【SCENE 07｜9.5–11s｜TURN THE PAGE｜PAPER TYPOGRAPHY】A storm of paper suddenly erupts from the darkness. She now wears a distressed gray-blue denim cropped top, charcoal-black asymmetric low-rise mini skirt, and silver waist chain, positioned slightly left of center. Large quantities of white paper, black paper, deep pink magazine paper, and burgundy paper fragments fly through the space at high speed. Simultaneously, “THE” forms along both sides of her body, while a gigantic “PAGE” expands from behind her toward the camera. She swings one hand. WHOOSH! The entire “TURN THE PAGE” structure flips like an enormous Fashion Magazine from in front of her to behind her. The camera races between flying sheets of paper. Sheets passing extremely close to the lens create realistic Motion Blur.【SCENE 08｜11–13s｜LIVE BY YOUR RULES｜RIBBON TYPOGRAPHY】The music reaches maximum intensity. She instantly changes into the Final Dark Idol Look: black asymmetric cropped top, black layered ultra-short skirt, silver waist chain, black choker, silver earrings, black knee-high boots. She stands exactly in the center and performs a fast turn. Large amounts of real Hot Pink, deep burgundy, and black ribbons explode from behind her. The ribbons must have realistic weight, folds, reflections, inertia, and aerodynamic drag. The first ribbon group shoots from behind her left shoulder, curves over her head into the extreme foreground to form “LIVE”, then continues around and behind her. The second group emerges again from behind her right side, crosses in front of her waist, and forms “BY YOUR”. The third group rises from around her feet, spirals around her legs, then angles toward the camera to form “RULES”. Eventually “LIVE BY YOUR RULES” becomes a gigantic 3D Typography Spiral. Typography continuously moves from foreground → side → background → extreme foreground → back behind her. She genuinely stands inside the center of the typographic vortex. The camera performs a high-speed 360° Orbit around her while the character and Ribbon Typography rotate in opposite directions. On the final BOOM, all ribbons instantly freeze and the complete phrase “LIVE BY YOUR RULES” remains clearly readable once.【SCENE 09｜13–15s｜CHOOSE YOUR LIFE｜IRIS TYPOGRAPHY TUNNEL】Hard Cut to an Extreme Macro of both eyes, filling almost the entire 16:9 frame. Preserve exactly the same eye shape, eye makeup, bangs, eyebrows, and realistic skin texture from @Image1. A tiny Hot Pink light appears in the center of the pupil. Deep inside the iris, “CHOOSE” gradually appears, followed by “YOUR”, then “LIFE”, forming “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE”. The typography is NOT printed onto the eyeball surface; it exists as miniature 3D Neon Typography suspended deep inside the iris. The camera suddenly rushes toward the right pupil and enters it. The pupil instantly transforms into a gigantic black + Hot Pink typography environment. Countless repetitions of “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE” extend through spatial depth to form an Infinite Typography Tunnel. Nearby typography is enormous, mid-distance typography is medium-sized, distant typography becomes progressively smaller, creating extreme infinite perspective. The camera races through the typography tunnel while gigantic letters sweep past from the left, right, above, and below. Finally, all typography suddenly collapses toward the center. In the middle of the black space, only one complete and clearly readable “CHOOSE YOUR LIFE” remains. The Hot Pink light contracts into a single point. Final Bass Hit: the girl blinks, instant cut to black.【TEXT ACCURACY｜HIGHEST PRIORITY】The following phrases must be generated exactly and spelled correctly: FREE YOUR MIND; LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY; BECOME WHO YOU CHOOSE; LET YOUR FUTURE BLOOM; POWER YOUR CHOICE; STEP INTO YOUR STORY; TURN THE PAGE; LIVE BY YOUR RULES; CHOOSE YOUR LIFE. No gibberish, random letters, extra words, or spelling errors. Even during high-speed typography movement, every phrase must have at least 0.3–0.5 seconds of complete, stable, clearly readable presentation.【ALL NINE SCENES MUST HAVE CLEARLY DIFFERENT COMPOSITIONS】01 Frontal full-body + Smoke Typography across foreground/midground/background; 02 Extreme Face Close-Up + Neon wrapping around the face in an S-shaped 3D path; 03 Extreme Low Angle + giant Chrome Typography architecture; 04 90° Top Shot + character centered inside a botanical typography ring; 05 frontal wide-angle forced perspective + Electric Typography in the foreground; 06 ultra-wide side view + Side Tracking + character walking into Shadow Typography; 07 Dutch Angle + Paper Typography flipping from foreground to background; 08 centered character + Ribbon Typography surrounding her in 360° space; 09 Extreme Eye Macro + Infinite Typography Tunnel. prompts.text:
【核心创意】

15 秒，16:9 横屏视频。东方传统漆画与螺钿镶嵌动画风格。红海、沙漠、天空和人物像一幅厚重的东方漆画浮雕，由黑漆、朱漆、沙金色、深蓝色漆面和蓝绿色螺钿组成。海浪具有贝壳镶嵌的反光纹理，山脉带有金色雕刻线和漆面开片。无对白。

摩西是一名年长男性，灰白色长胡须，穿米色长袍和深棕色披肩，手持木杖。全片保持脸部轮廓、胡须、服装和比例一致。

【画面过程说明】

0–3 秒｜极大全景：
朱红色漆面天空下，逃亡人群来到深蓝色漆海前。海浪由层叠的蓝绿色螺钿浮雕构成，像两面高大的墙挡住道路。摩西站在人群前方，举起木杖。

3–6 秒｜中景：
摩西将木杖指向海面。两侧蓝色漆面海浪开始向左右分开，金色雕刻线从海底中央向前延伸，逐渐形成一条沙金色道路。

6–9 秒｜俯拍：
红海完全分开，两面深蓝色螺钿水墙高高立起。人群沿中央道路向前行走，人物以简洁的漆器浮雕剪影表现，动作清晰有节奏。

9–12 秒｜侧面跟拍：
镜头沿金色道路向前移动，前景的螺钿水墙产生层叠反光和空间变化。摩西最后走入道路中央，回头确认人群已经通过。

12–15 秒｜大全景：
人群抵达远方沙金色岸边。摩西放下木杖，两侧漆面海浪缓慢向中央合拢，金色雕刻线逐渐消失，海面恢复平静。镜头拉远，金色阳光照亮摩西和人群。

声音：木杖触地声、漆面震动声、螺钿水纹碰撞声、风声、脚步声、低沉鼓点和庄严弦乐。海水合拢后转为平静流水声。无对白、无旁白。

不想要：纸张、剪纸、真实流体模拟、普通3D海水、现代服装、现代船只、人物飞行、海水爆炸、漆面融化、螺钿碎裂、字幕、Logo、乱码文字、黑屏转场。

必须保持：全片为东方传统漆画与螺钿镶嵌动画；摩西始终穿米色长袍、深棕披肩并手持木杖；红海必须从中央向左右两侧分开；结尾海水重新合拢，但摩西和人群安全抵达岸边。

prompts.text:
【REFERENCE】
Image1 `01 / SCENE_TRAPPED`：本の中に閉じ込められた第一場面、巨大本、室内、人物の位置とポーズ。
Image2 `02 / SCENE_BREAKTHROUGH`：ページを押し破る第二場面、動作、紙の亀裂。
Image3 `03 / SCENE_EMERGENCE`：現実へ出た第三場面、破れ穴、着地位置。
Image4 `04 / SCENE_ENCOUNTER`：本の中の自分と対面する第四場面の左右、指差し、巨大本。
Image5 `05 / WOMAN_MASTER`：利用者が差し替える女性全身アンカー。顔、髪、年齢感、肌、体型、全身比率、衣装、素材、配色、靴の唯一の正本。
`06 / MANGA_SELF`：05を同じ人物・衣装のままモノクロ漫画化した状態。
`07 / REAL_SELF`：05を正確に維持した実写状態。
`08 / BOOK_ROOM`：01～04共通の巨大な見開き本、木製床、寝具、カーテン、植物、暖かな昼光の寝室。

各ショットはIDだけで参照する。01～04の女性からは位置、ポーズ、動作だけを使い、外見は使わない。人物同一性は05を最優先し、06と07を同一人物の二状態とする。女性アンカーの差し替えごとに05から読み直す。場面アンカーの吹き出し、印刷文字、コマ枠、白い分割余白は使わない。

【CONDITION DEFINITION】
15秒、1:1。シネマティック実写と精密なモノクロ漫画の融合。実写は自然な肌、布、髪、暖かな立体光、漫画は紙目、網点、インク線を明瞭に分ける。4パネルは物語アンカーで、カット数は4つに限定しない。前半は真剣な脱出劇、最後は「自分が本の中に残る」不条理を驚きとパロディーへ転換。表情は困惑→恐怖→決意→安堵→違和感→強い驚き。顔を変形させず眉、瞳、口、顎、肩、呼吸を連動する。0.0～4.6秒は全身を本の印刷面内に閉じ込めた平面モノクロ漫画とし、紙の内側から現実側へ押す。肌色、実写衣装、立体化、身体突出、床への接地は4.6秒から。

【SHOT / FLOW】
0.0～1.0秒【参照：01、06、08】巨大本を低い広角で見せ、本の中へ高速プッシュイン。MANGA_SELFは困惑して見回し、眉が寄り呼吸が浅くなる。
1.0～3.3秒【参照：01、06】顔、境界を探る手、紙を押す横顔をハードカット。目が泳ぎ口元が震える。紙越しに「ここは……どこ？　出られない……」。継ぎ目を見つけ、恐怖から決意へ。
3.3～4.6秒【参照：02、06、08】低い斜め前方。踏ん張る靴、紙へ食い込む指、歯を食いしばる顔を三連続で切る。「あいて……！」。集中線と黒インクの圧力リングが手から広がる。
4.6～6.8秒【参照：02、05、06、07、08】紙が現実側へ膨らみ、手、顔、上半身、脚の順に平面のインクと紙繊維が07の肌、髪、衣装へ連続変換。境界で網点が色粒子へ変わる。カメラは裂け目を半周し、立体化に合わせ被写界深度を浅くする。破裂時、手描きの`バリッ！`が手前へ飛び、黒インク片へ砕け0.35秒以内に消える。女性は一人のまま05を維持する。
6.8～8.4秒【参照：03、05、07、08】REAL_SELFが紙片と床へ着地し少しよろける。低い追従から顔へ寄る。両手と参照衣装を確認し、驚きが安堵と小さな笑みへ。「出られた……？」。
8.4～10.3秒【参照：05、07、08】乾いたページ音。BGMに合わせ笑みが止まり、口角が落ち、眉が上がり、瞳だけ本へ動く。つばを飲み恐る恐る振り向く。顔から本へ高速ホイップパンし、肩越しのまま10.3秒の04へ接続。安堵が違和感へ変わる。
10.3～11.2秒【参照：04、05、06、07、08】左右が読める中広角。左のREAL_SELFと本の中央のMANGA_SELFが同時に指を差し、終端で短くヒットストップ。BGMはレコードスクラッチで急停止。
11.2～12.8秒【参照：04、05、06】MANGA_SELFへスマッシュズーム。目と口を大きく開き、頬のハッチングが増える。紙越しに「まさか……本当に出てきた！？」。背後に放射状の漫画線。
12.8～14.0秒【参照：04、05、07】85mm相当でREAL_SELFの顔へスマッシュズーム。05の顔比率を保ち、眉が跳ね、瞳孔が縮み、口が開き、肩が引ける。短い間の後、室内音声で「あなた……誰？」。
14.0～15.0秒【参照：04、05、07】85mmのまま一段近い驚き顔。顔と衣装はカラー、背景だけ白黒ハーフトーンと集中線へ変わり、巨大な`！？`が頭の後ろから出て一度弾む。本、カメラ、本の順に二度見し、コミカルな一音で終了。

【CAMERA / EDITING】
広角、顔、手元、低角度、短い回り込み、ホイップパン、交互スマッシュズームを使い、同じ中広角を続けない。動作か表情変化で切り、長い静止、スロー、無目的な360度回転、フェードなし。最終4.7秒は対面、交互リアクション、驚き顔アップの順に加速。

【MOTION GRAPHICS / TYPOGRAPHY】
集中線、ハーフトーン、インクの圧力リング、短いヒットストップ、紙片の奥行きを使う。`バリッ！`は黒インク、`！？`は白文字に赤いずれ影。わずかにオーバーシュートし、顔を隠さない。表示文字はこの二つだけで字幕や吹き出しにしない。

【SOUND】
overall_soundscape:

prompts.text:
Hailuo Minimax H3 prompt

@ Image1 is the sole visual authority for the folio spread, the wren, the hazel twig, the egg study, the foot sketch, the handwriting, the printed type, the paper, the foxing, the lighting, the palette, the layout and the horizontal composition.

Animate this exact page without redesigning it. Preserve every existing mark, letter and colour in its final state.

[Goal] Create a 15-second sequence in which this plate makes itself, and then the bird inside it comes quietly alive. One continuous, locked, straight-on overhead composition. No camera movement, no cuts, no cropping, no perspective change, no page turning.

[Sequence]  0-2.4 seconds: Begin on blank aged ivory paper — the empty spread, correct in paper texture, chain lines, foxing and lighting, but carrying no image, no writing and no type. A faint graphite underdrawing appears across the right page in light searching strokes, finding the wren's posture and the line of the twig.
A few construction marks overshoot and are left uncorrected.

2.4-6 seconds: Engraved ink linework draws itself over the pencil, following the exact contours of the finished plate — outline first, then hatching building the shadow under the wing, the barring of the tail, the texture of the twig. The rectangular plate mark presses into the paper around the image with a soft physical impression, lifting the paper very slightly at its edge.

6-10.5 seconds: Watercolour floods in. Washes enter the printed outlines and settle into them, warm russet across the back, buff along the eyebrow stripe, muted olive on the twig, each wash landing exactly within the shapes of the finished plate and overrunning the line in the same few places the reference does.

The colour blooms wet and then visibly dries, darkening slightly at the edges. On the left page, the sepia handwriting writes itself line by line from the top, in a period cursive hand that is elegant, cramped and only partly legible. The small egg study fills with colour and the pencil foot sketch appears faintly beside it.
10.5-13 seconds: The printed type impresses into the right page — TROGLODYTES TROGLODYTES, then The Common Wren beneath it, then PLATE XVII in the top right corner. Foxing spots deepen. The last details resolve: the highlight in the bird's eye, the fine barring on the flank. The page settles. Everything on the spread is now exactly as in @[ref img].  13-15 seconds: The page stays completely still and completely flat

— it is paper and it behaves like paper. But the printed bird begins to breathe. Its flank rises and falls very slightly. It blinks once. It turns its head a few degrees and holds, alert, looking past the viewer at something outside the page. The cocked tail gives one small twitch. It does not fly, it does not leave the plate, it does not become three-dimensional, and it does not look at the viewer. Settle into a living idle: the bird breathing, one more slow blink, the paper still.  Render as photoreal archival photography of a real object under warm north-window light. Keep the printed page flat and matte with no glow, no emission, no glint and no digital sheen.

Keep the two motion layers distinct: the page is a made thing being made, the bird is alive. Keep all type, handwriting, marks and geometry fixed once they appear.  Do not introduce any new text, letters, numerals, marks, birds, objects, hands, tools, logos, captions, borders, watermarks or page numbers. Do not turn or lift the page. Do not move, rotate or scale the camera. Do not zoom. Do not add glow, neon, coloured light, lens flare, bokeh or shallow-focus racking.

Do not make the bird photoreal or three-dimensional — it must remain a hand-coloured engraving that happens to be alive. Do not have it fly, hop, open its beak wide, or leave the plate.

Audio: fine graphite scratching on rough paper; the dry precise scrape of a steel nib; the deep soft compression of a plate press; a sable brush loaded with water moving across paper; paper fibres settling; the quiet room tone of a study with a slow long-case clock ticking somewhere behind.
At 13 seconds, one Eurasian wren song — sudden, intricate and far louder than anything that small should produce — then the room tone returns and the clock keeps going. No music, no dialogue, no narration, no electronic tones.

prompts.text:
️

【核心创意】

15秒，16:9横版人类进化史科普短片。使用现代扁平矢量插画与信息图动画风格，通过一条从左向右展开的连续时间长卷，表现人类祖先从共同灵长类祖先分化、直立行走、使用工具与火、迁徙合作，最终发展为现代智人的过程。

科学表达采用分支式演化树，不表现现代猿猴直接变成人。整体为纯2D矢量视觉：简洁几何图形、统一深色描边、平面色块、有限色板、轮廓清晰、平滑形状变形。色彩从史前赭石、沙黄逐渐过渡到现代深蓝、青绿色。

全片采用连续向右移动的横向镜头，不硬切。每个时代通过轮廓、火焰、石器、洞穴线条和迁徙路线自然变形进入下一阶段。

【画面过程说明】

0–3秒：
米白色背景上，一棵由简洁线条组成的演化树从画面中央生长。树枝向不同方向分叉，其中一条支系延伸为生活在非洲森林边缘的早期人族剪影。

早期人族从弯腰行走逐渐变成较稳定的双足站立姿态。身体变化通过平滑矢量轮廓变形完成，不出现写实肌肉和恐怖形变。

镜头缓慢向右移动。树枝线条自然延伸成为草原地平线。

3–6秒：
进入非洲草原场景。早期人属以双足行走，手中拿起简单石块，将石块敲击成锋利石器。敲击产生的三角形碎片在空中旋转，变成橙红色几何火花。

火花聚集成一团扁平矢量火焰。人物围绕火焰取暖、分享食物，表现工具、火和群体合作。

人物外形保持简洁剪影，不出现夸张野人形象。

6–9秒：
火焰向右拉伸，变成地图上的橙色迁徙路线。镜头继续向右平移，背景转化为简化的大陆轮廓。

多个人类支系以不同颜色的矢量剪影沿分支路线迁徙。部分人物穿着简单兽皮、携带工具，在寒冷环境中合作前行。

迁徙路线必须表现为多个分支，不是一条单向直线。

9–12秒：

prompts.text:
ULTRA REALISTIC 15 SECOND PERSONAL HOME VIDEO. 1080p 16:9 widescreen render of mid 1990s Hi8 camcorder tape footage. Single continuous handheld take, no cuts. Dialogue driven, Korean. Title: GASOLINE DREAMS.

CONCEPT
1997. A borrowed car at a rural highway petrol station outside Seoul, dusk in late autumn. Three hours still to drive. She is waiting for the tank to fill and her friend is filming instead of reading the map. Nothing happens. The tape is just running.

SUBJECT LOCK
Korean woman, early twenties. Realistic skin with visible pores, faint under eye shadow, minimal makeup, nose and ears pink from the cold, breath faintly visible. Dark brown hair loosely tied back, front strands loose, flattened on one side from sleeping against the car window. Oversized cream knit sweater with stretched cuffs pulled down over her hands, blue jeans, white sneakers scuffed at the toe. Same face, hair and outfit for the full 15 seconds. Slouched, stiff from sitting, stretching her back.

SECOND VOICE LOCK
The friend holding the camcorder is never seen, not a hand, not a shadow, not a reflection in the car glass. Voice only, young female, close to the mic, sleepy and unbothered. Never addresses an audience. A station attendant in a padded work jacket is visible at a distance but never speaks.

SETTING
Small rural petrol station on a two lane highway outside Seoul, late autumn dusk, 1997. Two pumps under a concrete canopy with one flickering fluorescent tube, a stack of oil cans, a plastic stool, a beige sedan with the fuel flap open and the passenger door hanging open. Beyond the canopy, bare rice paddies, a line of poplars, low grey hills, a truck passing, sky going orange to deep blue. Lived in and unstyled. No visible brands, no logos, no readable signage, no Hangul text anywhere in frame.

FRAMING
16:9 widescreen throughout, treated as a later widescreen transfer of the original tape. The extra width is used badly, not compositionally. She sits low and off to one side with dead empty space filling the other half of the frame. Horizon slightly tilted. Nothing centred on purpose.

CAMERA
Raw handheld Hi8 camcorder at chest height, operator leaning on the car. Autofocus hunting between the pump, the car glass and her face, repeatedly grabbing the wrong thing. Exposure pumping hard as the lens drifts from the bright sky to the shade under the canopy. One lazy unmotivated zoom that overshoots past her shoulder and corrects. She drifts out of frame once and the operator is late to follow. Analogue tape noise, chroma bleed on the orange sky, mild tracking wobble at the frame edges, one dropout glitch. No stabilization, no gimbal, no cinematic choreography.

BEATS
0:00 to 0:04 She climbs out of the passenger door mid stretch, arms up, yawning, and walks toward the pump. The camera swings after her too slowly and catches empty canopy for a beat.
0:04 to 0:08 She stands at the open fuel flap watching the numbers on the pump. The exchange, overlapping, both half laughing.
0:08 to 0:12 Dead air. She sits sideways on the car bonnet, feet not reaching the ground, a hot can held against her cheek, watching a truck pass. Nobody speaks for four full seconds. The fluorescent tube flickers.
0:12 to 0:15 A horn from the road. She slides off the bonnet, says the last line without turning around, and the camera is still pointed at the empty bonnet when the tape cuts.

DIALOGUE
Spoken language locked to Korean, casual banmal between friends, flat and unprojected, thinned by the camcorder mic.
0:05 She says Gadeuk chaewoya dwae, apeuro amugeotdo eopseo
0:07 Friend off camera says Neo don isseo
0:08 She says Dangyeonhi eopji
0:13 She says Gaja, got eoduwojinda
Visible mouth movement with bilabial closure on the m, b and p sounds. Friend line off camera only, closer to the mic. No other speech, no narration.

AUDIO
Diegetic only. Fuel pump motor humming, nozzle clicking off, fluorescent ballast buzz, a truck passing with a doppler horn, wind across open paddies, a can tab, her sneakers on grit, faint hand noise on the camcorder body. No music, no score, no radio, no added ambience beds.

STYLE RULES
Nothing dramatic happens on purpose. No posing, no road trip montage energy, no wind in hair, no golden hour beauty lighting, no hero framing. Realism comes from the cold, the flat delivery and the four seconds of dead air nobody bothered to cut. She is talking to her friend, not to viewers. If she performs for the lens the illusion breaks.

NEGATIVE
No music. No subtitles. No captions. No watermark. No timestamp burn in. No slow motion. No colour grading. No lens flare. No shallow depth of field. No visible second person. No brand logos. No readable text.

LAST FRAME
Wide crooked frame of the empty car bonnet under the flickering fluorescent tube with the dark highway filling the right half, image tears with one frame of tape distortion, then hard cut to black. Absolutely no on screen text, no title card, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no signage of any kind in the final frame.

prompts.text:
@image1 完全按照参考图呈现,不重新设计角色。面部五官比例、金色浮雕铠甲纹样、服装剪裁与巨剑造型,全片保持严格一致,不因动作幅度、镜头角度或光线变化产生偏差。

武器锁定:全片只使用这把巨剑,不出现任何其他武器或道具。

场景:高处开阔的灰白岩石台地,四周散布着大小不一的巨岩,最远处矗立一块屋子大小的黑色巨岩。天空是清透的灰蓝色,浮着几片白云。侧向强光在岩石上投下长影。空气中悬浮着细小浮尘,被光线照出颗粒感;岩缝间偶有暗红余烬般的光点隐约明灭。

剑的机制:剑身表面是焦黑的炭质外壳,壳下裂缝中流动着橙红熔岩,流速与亮度随她的发力实时联动——蓄力时如心跳般规律搏动,全力挥砍前的瞬间由暗转亮。剑尖始终有熔融的橙红液滴缓慢垂落,落地后凝成一小块暗红结晶。每完成一次切割,炭壳裂缝会略微扩大、露出更多内部熔光,全片末段剑刃发光面积明显多于开场,形成清晰的能量攀升弧线。

切割效果铁律:她的剑不是劈开岩石,而是熔穿它。每一道切口必须呈现完整过程——刃口经过处岩面先烧成暗红并向内塌软,断面呈现熔融的橙红发光切面并挂着流动的熔滴,岩块随后才顺着切面滑开分离,分离时切面之间拉出细长的熔融丝线。切割瞬间偶有细小岩屑因高温爆裂点状飞溅,带着橙色光点划出短促弧线。所有发光切口在全片持续发亮不熄灭,断面的橙红光晕实时照亮她的铠甲表面与周边岩壁,形成随光源移动的动态反光;岩石落地时溅出的熔渣与火星留在地面累积。

视觉效果:挥剑时刃后拖出扭曲空气与橙红热痕;高温使剑刃周围空气持续升腾扭曲;熔滴落地激起细小火星与青烟,余烬如萤火虫般在空中缓慢飘升;岩石碎块被斩飞时带着燃烧的边缘旋转;切割瞬间自切口喷出一道细长白炽气流,剑刃全亮时刃线周围溢出轻微白色光晕;她的发丝与衣摆被上升热气不均匀地掀动,呈现不对称的飘动。命中瞬间插入纯白冲击帧,全片共两次(4.5-6秒与10.5-12.5秒)。高速动作段落(1.5-3秒、3-4.5秒、7.5-9秒、10.5-12.5秒)叠加笔刷质感速度线与三重残影,缓慢或静态镜头不套用此效果。

动作原则:视线先到、剑刃后到。挥剑前肩膀先转、腰胯发力、手臂最后到位,收势时手腕再补一记轻甩为刃部增速。每次落剑后剑尖因巨剑重量继续下沉半拍;大力劈砍后她的躯干会顺着剑势多转一点角度才收住,呈现真实惯性与延迟,而非机械式一刀归位。落地时膝盖沉降缓冲、脚尖抓地。她全程双手与单手交替持握,换手时剑柄在掌中转半圈。呼吸与发力同步——蓄力时短促吸气,发力瞬间从齿间压出短促吐息,大招前肩背明显起伏。每一击节奏不完全相同:部分快、脆、一闪而过,部分沉、重、带延迟惯性,避免全片动作节奏单一化。

风格:2.5D剧场版动漫,赛璐璐上色配厚涂光影,线条锐利。冷色调环境(灰白岩石、灰蓝天空)与炽热橙红剑光形成互补色对比。模拟35mm变形宽银幕镜头:横向椭圆散景、浅景深。16:9,4K,24帧,15秒。镜头每1.5秒换一个角度,不重复。

声音:熔岩流动的低沉咕噜声、炭壳开裂的细碎脆响、巨剑破空的沉重呼啸、岩石熔穿时的滋滋声、岩块滑开与落地的闷响、熔滴滴落的轻响、冲刺时靴底碾过碎石的摩擦声、她的呼吸与发力吐息。没有音乐。

0-1.5秒 微距特写,浅景深:镜头贴着剑身缓慢滑过,焦黑炭壳裂缝里橙红熔岩如心跳般规律搏动,一颗熔滴垂落拉长后坠地溅起火星。焦点后拉,她双手握住剑柄,指节逐一收紧,黑色指甲压进缠绳。她垂眼看向第一块巨岩,瞳孔微微收紧锁定目标。

1.5-3秒 侧面平移追踪,与她同速:右脚踏前瞬间脚跟先着地抓稳,腰胯先转带动双臂甩出,巨剑横向扫过第一块巨岩。刃口经过处岩面瞬间烧成暗红塌软,断面亮起熔融橙光,细小岩屑带火星四溅。岩石停半拍后顺切面滑开两半,切面间拉出数条熔丝,橙光映上她的铠甲侧面。她收剑时剑尖因重量继续下沉半拍。

3-4.5秒 低角度仰拍:两块巨岩立于她两侧。她脚尖为轴原地半旋,双手举剑过顶,先是一记快、脆的斩击劈向左侧,再借剑势惯性沉重地回身劈向右侧,一快一重形成节奏对比。两道切口几乎同时亮起,四块岩体外滑砸地,溅起熔渣青烟,几缕余烬缓缓升起。她落定时双膝微屈,发丝被热气不均匀地掀向一侧。

4.5-6秒 极近垂直特写:她双臂完全伸展将剑举过头顶,肩背明显收紧蓄力,剑身裂缝里熔岩流速骤然加快、亮度提升。随即整个躯干下沉发力垂直劈落,牙关咬紧、短促吐息喷出——剑刃自高大立岩顶端一路熔穿至底部,岩体沿切面倒向两侧,切口喷出细长白炽气流。插入纯白冲击帧,镜头随冲击轻微震动。

6-7.5秒 侧向缓慢横移,体积光穿过热气:她剑尖点地稍作停顿,肩膀剧烈起伏,呼出一口白气,重心在两脚间轻轻晃动找回平衡。镜头横移扫过身后——三处切口仍明亮燃烧,熔滴缓缓垂落,地面已积起暗红结晶与青烟,橙光在她脸颊与铠甲上跳动反射。剑柄在掌中转半圈换到另一只手。

7.5-9秒 高速环绕加速:数块小岩石被她一脚踢向空中。她双脚蹬地纵身跃起,膝盖微收加快转速,空中旋身一圈连续挥剑四次,每一击手臂完全伸展并在末端补一记手腕轻甩——每块岩石被熔穿的瞬间亮起橙色断面,燃烧的边缘

cases.title: 金铠女剑士岩台动作戏

prompts.text:
## 参照キャラクター指定

* ** Image1**：ピンク髪の少女。冒頭と終盤のメイン。作品の顔。

* ** Image2**：ダーク衣装の銀髪少女。影・異質感・変質表現担当。

* ** Image3**：白銀ショートヘアの少女。`KNIGHT` / `RIFT` 担当。

* ** Image4**：金髪の白衣装の少女。収束・静けさ・終盤象徴カット担当。

## 全体指示

**15秒、16:9、横長。**

白・黒・赤を基調にした、極太の縦長サンセリフタイポグラフィと4人のファンタジー系アニメキャラクターを組み合わせた高密度グラフィックPV。

文字は字幕ではなく、**空間レイヤー、遮蔽、トンネル、マスク、画面構造そのもの**として機能する。

アニメ調の細線キャラクター、フラット寄りの陰影、強いグリッチ、横走査線、赤い円形UI、色収差、短いフラッシュ切り替え。

全体は、

**静かな人物提示 → タイポ変形 → キャラクター切り替え → レイピアによる空間切断 → 圧縮空間 → 崩壊 → 収束 → 冒頭回帰**

の流れ。

テンポを落とさず、**0.5秒ごとに画面構造・人物・文字・動きのいずれかを必ず変化させる。**

## 使用文字

* **`FANTASY`**

* **`KNIGHT`**

* **`SIGIL`**

* **`FACE`**

* **`LINE`**

* **`RIFT`**

---

## 0.0–0.5秒

白背景。

巨大な **`FANTASY`** が画面いっぱいに並ぶ。

右上に ** Image1** の横顔が少しだけ見切れる。

薄い水平グリッチ。

---

## 0.5–1.0秒

**`FANTASY`** が左へ高速スライド。

Image1 は一度消え、白地と巨大な黒文字だけになる。

文字の一部が画面外にはみ出す。

---

## 1.0–1.5秒

**`FANTASY`** の文字の隙間から ** Image1** 現れる。うつむき気味で目を閉じている。文字が人物の前後を通り、身体の一部を遮蔽する。---## 1.5–2.0秒 Image1 がわずかに顔を上げて目を開く。顔の輪郭と瞳が明瞭になる。同時に **`FANTASY`** が横方向へ圧縮され始める。---## 2.0–2.5秒短い白フラッシュ。巨大な **`FACE`** に切り替わる。人物は消え、中央に赤黒の同心円UI。強い水平グリッチと色収差。---## 2.5–3.0秒**`KNIGHT`** が巨大に出現。その文字の隙間から ** Imag3** が正面寄りに現れる。白銀の髪と青緑系衣装を明確に見せる。---## 3.0–3.5秒 Image3 が右向きの横顔になる。**`KNIGHT`** が人物の前後を横切りながら右へ流れる。赤い細線UIが一瞬走る。---## 3.5–4.0秒**`KNIGHT LINE`** に切り替わる。人物はいったん消える。白黒で画面を大胆に分割し、赤を一点だけ強く使う。---## 4.0–4.5秒巨大な **`LINE`** が横方向へ引き伸ばされる。文字の一部が極端に細くなり、一部は太く圧縮される。画面に強い横方向の張力を作る。---## 4.5–5.0秒背景が黒寄りへ反転。細いアウトラインの **`SIGIL`**。中央に ** Image2**。背後または隣に、** Image1の薄いピンク色のシルエット**が背中合わせ気味に重なる。---## 5.0–5.5秒 Image2 と  Image1 のシルエット位置がわずかにずれる。多重露光のような残像。**`SIGIL`** も複数レイヤーへ分離する。---## 5.5–6.0秒 Image1 のシルエットが消える。** Image2** が画面中央へ集約。背後に淡い赤色の円形UI。次のアクションへ向けて一瞬静止。---## 6.0–6.5秒高速フラッシュで **`RIFT`** に切り替わる。** Image3** が細身のレイピアを構える。白背景、青い斜めライン、赤い円形UI。文字は人物の前後に食い込んでいる。---## 6.5–7.0秒 Image3がレイピアを鋭く横薙ぎする。剣先の軌跡に沿って、**画面空間そのものが切り裂かれる。**白い斬撃線と赤い発光。**`RIFT`** の中央も切断される。---## 7.0–7.5秒 Image3が一歩踏み込み、二撃目。レイピアを裂け目へ突き込む。切断された **`RIFT`** の文字が上下または前後にずれる。青いラインも同時に切断される。---## 7.5–8.0秒レイピアの軌跡から黒い亀裂が一気に拡大。**`RIFT`** が歪み、文字としての形を失い始める。赤いデジタルノイズと色収差が急増する。---## 8.0–8.5秒破断した画面が一気に暗部へ吸い込まれる。ほぼ暗転。わずかな赤い残光と水平ノイズだけを残す。---## 8.5–9.0秒暗闇の中央に細い縦スリット。その中に ** Image2** が小さく現れる。左右は黒いマスク。人物だけが圧縮された異界空間に閉じ込められているように見せる。---## 9.0–9.5秒縦スリットが少し広がる。 Image2 の顔と衣装が明瞭になる。仮面・儀式・異界を連想させる演出。赤い円弧が背後に出現する。---## 9.5–10.0秒背後に赤い円形UI。薄い **`LINE`** が人物と重なる。 Image2は中央に静止。奥へ続くグリッドが現れ始める。---## 10.0–10.5秒**`LINE`** が立体的に多重化。文字とフレームがトンネルのように奥へ連続する。 Image2 を中央に残し、背景だけが高速で後退する。---## 10.5–11.0秒トンネルがさらに深くなる。赤い線と白い線が奥へ吸い込まれる。文字・UI・グリッドの境界が徐々に崩れる。---## 11.0–11.5秒左から巨大な白いスラッシュ状エフェクト。画面全体を横断する。**`LINE`** と空間フレームが押し潰され、赤いグリッチが急増。---## 11.5–12.0秒 Image2 がグリッチに埋もれて消える。**`SIGIL` / `LINE`** が波打ちながら崩壊。水平の赤いノイズが画面を横切る。---## 12.0–12.5秒黒太字の **`SIGIL`** が円形に配置される。中央に渦巻き状のトンネルUI。その中央から ** Image4** が静かに現れる。---## 12.5–13.0秒円形 **`SIGIL`** が拡大。渦巻きが楕円状に伸びる。 Image4 はほぼ静止したまま、周囲だけが激しく変形する。清浄で象徴的な印象。---## 13.0–13.5秒画面全体が横方向へ強く引き伸ばされる。 Image4と渦巻きが光の残像になり、白へ溶ける。短いフラッシュで終盤へ。---## 13.5–14.0秒再び巨大な **`FANTASY`**。** Image1** が右下寄りに現れる。冒頭と同じ構図を思わせるが、今度は正面寄り。---## 14.0–14.5秒**`FANTASY`** が左へ流れる。 Image1 は静かに目を閉じ、わずかにうつむく。右下に赤いノイズテキスト状グリッチ。---## 14.5–15.0秒 Image1が右方向へ画面外へ寄る。**`FANTASY`** も細く圧縮されて端へ消える。白背景。最後に短い赤い水平グリッチだけが残り、完全に消えて終了。---# 画面演出ルール* **15秒を超えない。*** 0.5秒単位で明確な視覚変化を作る。* 同じ人物・同じ構図を長時間固定しない。* タイポグラフィは常に人物の前後へ入り込み、字幕のように画面端へ置くだけにしない。* 文字そのものを**壁、マスク、トンネル、切断対象、空間構造**として扱う。* 白黒赤を全体の共通色とする。* キャラクター固有色はアクセントとして使用する。  * ** Image1：ピンク**  * ** Image2：紫黒**  * ** Image3：青緑**  * ** Image4：白金*** ** Image3 の `RIFT` 区間は中盤最大のアクションピーク。*** レイピアは敵を攻撃するのではなく、**文字、UI、画面、空間そのものを切断する。*** 斬撃によって発生した亀裂を、その後の圧縮空間・トンネル・崩壊演出へ因果的につなげる。*  Image4は戦闘させず、激しい崩壊後の静かな収束点として扱う。* 最後は  Image1に戻し、冒頭と終盤を視覚的に接続する。## 音* 強い電子ビート。* 文字切り替えごとの短いデジタルノイズ。* レイピアの斬撃には鋭い金属音＋デジタルスラッシュ。* 空間亀裂には低い衝撃音。* 8.0秒付近で一瞬音数を減らす。* 8.5秒以降から低音を再び立ち上げる。* 13.5秒の冒頭回帰でビートを強く戻す。* 15.0秒で短く明確に終了する。

prompts.text:
FORMAT:
15-second cinematic vertical car transformation film
9:16 aspect ratio
Ultra-realistic automotive commercial aesthetic
Japanese street culture + luxury cinematic realism
High-energy transformation pacing

CONCEPT:
“FROM STOCK TO STREET WEAPON”

A normal Maruti Suzuki Swift slowly transforms into a fully modified street machine through cinematic garage sequences, mechanical close-ups, aggressive lighting, and dramatic reveal shots.

TIMELINE:

0:00–0:02
Old stock white Maruti Suzuki Swift parked inside a dim industrial garage.
Dust particles in sunlight.
Static realistic atmosphere.
Soft engine ticking sounds.

0:02–0:04
Quick cinematic close-ups:
tools dropping on metal table,
garage lights turning on,
mechanic gloves tightening,
car jack lifting vehicle.
Fast-paced editing begins.

0:04–0:06
Transformation montage:
new alloy wheels installed,
wide tires mounted,
lowered suspension,
custom front bumper attached,
black spoiler fitted.
Mechanical sparks and cinematic motion blur.

0:06–0:08
Paint transformation sequence.
Original white paint peels away into glossy metallic midnight black.
Water droplets and reflections across body panels.
Neon garage lighting reflects on paint.

0:08–0:10
Interior upgrade shots:
digital dashboard glowing,
sport steering wheel,
bucket seats,
ambient red lighting,
push-start ignition.
Engine rev echoes.

0:10–0:12
Aggressive cinematic reveal:
modified Swift exits garage slowly.
Headlights turn on through smoke.
Low-angle tracking shots.
Wet asphalt reflections.
Turbo flutter sound.

0:12–0:15
Final hero sequence:
car speeding through empty city streets at night,
rolling shots,
drifting corner,
rain reflections,
motion blur,
camera orbit around vehicle.
End with parked hero shot under neon lights.

FINAL TEXT:
“SWIFT — REBORN.”

VISUAL STYLE:
Fast & Furious-inspired realism
Moody cinematic lighting
Japanese underground street-racing atmosphere
Wet asphalt reflections
Practical garage lighting
High-detail metallic textures
Subtle film grain
Deep contrast shadows
Realistic smoke and sparks

CAMERA:
ARRI Alexa Mini LF aesthetic
Anamorphic lens look
Low-angle tracking shots
Wheel close-ups

prompts.text:
Open ocean, storm-lit sky, two massive wooden galleons broadside to broadside, cannons blazing, sails torn and smoking.

LOCATION: towering waves, rain-slicked decks, splintering wood, the ships as looming wooden fortresses dwarfing the men fighting on them. Grey-green storm light, cannon smoke rolling across the water like fog.

ACTORS: two pirate crews — one crew in ragged dark coats and bandanas led by a scarred captain wielding a cutlass and flintlock; the other crew in stolen naval coats, more disciplined but outnumbered. Dozens of background fighters clashing across both decks.

MOVEMENT: heavy, physical combat — swinging on rigging ropes across the gap between ships, cutlass clashes with real weight and follow-through, men thrown by cannon blasts, boots slipping on wet planks.

INTERACTION: the two captains as the emotional throughline — circling each other through the chaos, their duel the spine of the sequence while the crews fight around them.

CINEMATOGRAPHY (Kubrick-style): open with a long, wide, almost painterly establishing shot of the two ships closing in through the storm — hold it, let the dread build before the first cannon fires. Use symmetry in the initial approach (ships mirrored on either side of frame), then shatter that order completely once battle erupts. Favor a few extended tracking shots through the melee (a single unbroken move weaving across the deck) rather than only quick cuts, so the audience feels physically present in the chaos, punctuated by hard cuts at moments of violence.

CUTS:

1. Wide establishing shot: the two galleons converging through rain and swell, lightning flashing behind torn sails, ominous and silent but for wind and creaking timber. Hold long.

2. Close-up: the pirate captain's face, rain streaming down a scarred cheek, eyes narrowing, hand tightening on his cutlass hilt.

3. Wide shot: cannons fire in unison from both ships — deafening flash and smoke, the hulls shuddering, wood splintering on impact, rigging snapping and crashing to the deck.

4. Grappling hooks fly across the gap, biting into the enemy ship's rail; ships lurch together with a groan of timber as the gap closes.

5. Long tracking shot: pirates swing across on ropes into the fray, landing mid-swing into combat — camera follows one pirate's full arc from rail to rail without cutting, weapons clashing all around as he lands and immediately engages.

6. Fast cuts through the melee: cutlass parries, a pistol shot at close range, a man thrown overboard by a cannon's recoil, barrels rolling loose across the tilting deck.

7. Medium shot: the two captains spot each other across the chaos, a beat of stillness in the middle of battle, then they cut a path toward one another through the fighting.

8. Close-up duel: blades clash in tight, brutal exchanges, rain and sweat, snarled dialogue, one captain slammed back against the mast.

9. Wide shot: a mast cracks and begins to fall, crew scattering, fire catching on torn sailcloth, chaos peaking as both crews scramble.

10. Final close combat: the rival captain disarmed, blade at his throat — beat of hesitation, thunder cracks, and the scene holds on the standoff rather than resolving cleanly, smoke and rain swirling around them both.

Camera: mostly handheld-feel tracking shots through the melee for immersion, hard cuts on cannon fire and key hits, a still symmetrical wide shot to open

prompts.text:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A 15-second, 16:9, cinematic photoreal image-to-video short set entirely inside the same vintage American bar interior. Preserve the exact same adult woman throughout: same face, proportions, hairstyle, makeup, dress, body, and realistic texture. The whole narrative stays in one continuous bar space only: black-and-white checker floor, red leather stools, metal counter edges, condensation on glass, warm hanging practicals, cool window edge light, faint red EXIT sign near the doorway, and a light haze of smoke and steam. No exterior, no extra people, no spatial jump, no identity drift. She is a mature retro bar hostess aura: powerful, sensual, elegant, dangerous, never vulgar, never static. The hidden story is that she seems to welcome a late guest, but is actually waiting to judge someone already marked. The camera follows one smooth line: low glide inward, rising follow, gentle half-orbit, drop to the table to find the prop, lift back to the face, lateral follow as she closes in, dangerous hand close-up, then a slight push-in ending. Lighting stays physically sourced: warm tungsten practicals and table reflections with cool window contour light. At 00:00.000-00:02.600, the camera glides low over checker tiles, stool legs, red leather, faint steam, and warm reflections. She walks in from behind the bar. Her boots enter first, steps slow and precise. Her right hand hooks a glass of amber liquor from the counter in one natural motion. Do not reveal the full face yet; show jawline, underside of the lip line, half a side face, and body rhythm through hips and waist. Her first layer is calm allure: relaxed brow peaks, outer eye corners slightly lowered, gaze not yet locking the camera, mouth corners lifted only faintly, breathing calm, chin slightly raised. The camera rises naturally with her. [Shot 2] At 00:02.600, the camera travels up from the wrist holding the glass into the key sensual close-up. Red lips, breath, collarbone, side face, outer eye, fingertips, and glass rim must read as beautiful, restrained, and dangerous. While walking, she brings the glass near her lips without drinking, letting the rim pass just in front of her mouth. Here the first micro-shift appears: her gaze hooks toward the camera direction but not into direct eye contact, sweeping lightly from the eye corner and withdrawing. Upper eyelids lower slightly. Lips part only a little. Breath exits softly through the nose. She says quietly in English: <d>[English] Took you long enough.</d> The voice is low, soft, slow, like a warm greeting with a hidden needle. The gentle half-orbit flows into placing the glass down. [Shot 3] At 00:05.100, she reaches the table and sets the glass down lightly. The camera follows the hand to the tabletop and discovers, in the same motion, a single upright bullet standing beside the glass. The bullet must feel native to the table arrangement. Do not force a facial reaction. Let her body shift slightly away while attention rests on the glass and bullet. The hostess softness still lingers but begins withdrawing. Her fingertips stay against the glass for half a beat longer, then leave slightly slower than before, deliberately allowing the danger to be seen. The bullet tip catches a thin cool highlight while the liquor remains warmly lit. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera rises from the table and bullet back to her face. She has already turned half her body and now stands between the table and a bar stool, with the doorway and blurred red EXIT sign behind. She looks briefly toward the door, then circles one stool and steps slowly closer. This is the key facial reversal: the shallow smile does not vanish first; the eyes cool first while the mouth keeps its curve. The brow center gathers slightly, softness at the eye corners tightens, upper lids lower a little, pupils become more concentrated, jawline tucks slightly more, breathing shallows, and the smile now reads as control rather than invitation. The camera moves laterally and slowly pushes in, keeping her as the active force. [Shot 5] At 00:10.200, cut naturally from her passing motion into a dangerous hand close-up. Her fingertips brush along the table edge and, with exquisite restraint, she gently tips the upright bullet over. It rolls half a turn and stops. The action feels practiced, casual, sensual, and colder than a gunshot. Her face can drift through soft focus in the background. She does not flick it; she nudges it with the pad and edge of the finger. Shoulder relaxed, wrist fluid, action continuous with the walk. The brass surface carries a moving highlight streak over the warm tabletop reflection. [Shot 6] At 00:12.800, the camera lifts from the bullet to a frontal close shot. She has stepped close and stopped, her face dominating frame while the background dissolves into warm lamps and blurred red EXIT color. She tilts her head by the smallest amount and lowers her chin slightly, finally looking directly into the camera. This is the judgment state. The flirtation is gone. Her eyes are steady and direct, never wide. The brow center compresses only slightly. The lips relax and close softly, with one corner holding the faintest cold smile. Breath is contained. Throat and jaw remain composed. She says in English: <d>[English] Tonight, you pay.</d> “Tonight” lands lightly; “you pay” drops lower, calm and judicial, never shouted. In the last half-second, the camera pushes in only slightly more and stops, letting the pressure come from distance rather than effects, with no black screen or transition.

overall_soundscape: Keep the sound intimate and spatially close: heels on tile, soft steam hiss, glass touching metal, leather and fabric friction, low bar hum, faint ventilation, and light room air. Bring breath, glass-rim movement, and lip-near glass tension forward under <d>[English] Took you long enough.</d>; make the glass touching the table the first rhythm point, then the bullet tip-over and half-roll the second. In the ending, reduce everything slightly so <d>[English] Tonight, you pay.</d> sits close and dry while low bar hum, tiny glass resonance, ventilation, and controlled breath remain underneath.

non_diegetic_music: Use minimal score. A very low elegant noir-like tension bed may sit beneath the space, but it must never dominate heels, glass, breath, or the bullet. Let the first half feel warmer and more seductive, cool it gradually through the middle, and support the final line only with a faint low pressure note, avoiding melodrama or any trailer-style punch.

CUT01｜時間：0.0-1.8秒｜Visuals：生成りホワイトの余白の大きい空間。画面右寄りに黒い人物シルエットの横顔。何もない静かな世界。人物が小さく「ク」と発音した瞬間、黒い「ク」が口から現れ、その後ろに小さなくすんだ赤の正方形が出現する。続けて「パ」と発音すると、赤い「パ」とオーカーの円が生まれる。最後に「ポ」で深い青の長方形が出る。人物は、自分の声で図形と文字が生まれたことに気づき、少しだけ顔を上げる。｜Camera：85mm｜F4｜横顔クローズアップ｜静かなドリーイン。｜Motion：文字と図形は発音ごとに1セットずつ直線的に滑り出る。人物は驚きでわずかに反応。｜Lighting：フラットで柔らかい均一光。｜VFX：紙の質感、ごく薄い押し出し、最小限の影。｜SFX：声のみ「ク」「パ」「ポ」。乾いた口音。｜Emotion：発見。静かなはじまり。｜Transition：最後に出た青い長方形が横へ伸び、次カットの構図線になる。

CUT03｜時間：3.6-5.4秒｜Visuals：真俯瞰。生成り背景に、今までの文字と図形が抽象的な配置を作っている。人物が中央を走る。人物は楽しくなって「クパポペ！」と一気に発音。発音に完全同期して「ク」「パ」「ポ」「ペ」が高速で一文字ずつ出現し、それぞれ黒い長方形、赤い正方形、青い円、オーカーの線へ接続される。4つの要素が組み合わさって大きな階段状の構成になる。人物はその上へ駆け上がる。｜Camera：24mm｜真俯瞰｜軽いロール。｜Motion：文字生成→構成変化→人物が走る。テンポは速め。｜Lighting：フラット。｜VFX：余白を保ちつつパララックスで奥行き。｜SFX：「ク・パ・ポ・ペ！」を早めに。｜Emotion：世界が広がる楽しさ。｜Transition：人物が最後の段を蹴った瞬間、重力方向が90度変わる。
CUT04｜時間：5.4-7.1秒｜Visuals：画面の天地がずれ、人物は横向きの重力で“壁”を歩く状態になる。背景には斜めの赤い長方形と青い円。人物は少し調子に乗って「パクポ！ ペクパ！」と発音。発音した順に「パ」「ク」「ポ」「ペ」「ク」「パ」が一文字ずつ現れ、壁の足場や橋になっていく。ところが最後の「パ」が出た瞬間、人物の影だけが本体から剥がれて別方向へ歩き出す。｜Camera：35mm｜ワイド｜水平を崩したダッチ構図。｜Motion：人物は壁歩き、影は独立して前進。｜Lighting：フラット。｜VFX：影の分離は平面的で抽象的に。｜SFX：「パ・ク・ポ！ ペ・ク・パ！」。速くて気持ちいいが少し不穏。｜Emotion：遊びが少し変になる。｜Transition：影が振り返り、口を開く。
CUT05｜時間：7.1-9.0秒｜Visuals：人物本体が左、独立した影が右。影が勝手に「ポ・パ・ク・ペ」と発音し、対応する「ポ」「パ」「ク」「ペ」を吐き出す。人物本体は驚いて、自分も「ク・パ・ポ」と応じる。双方の文字が空中で交差し、中央に抽象的な構成体を作る。ここで人物の口だけが顔から外れ、黒い楕円として中央に浮遊し始める。｜Camera：40mm｜左右対称に近い構図から、中央の浮遊口へゆっくり寄る。｜Motion：本体と影のコール＆レスポンス。最後に口が分離して浮く。｜Lighting：均一光。｜VFX：文字と図形の交差、口の平面分離。｜SFX：本体「ク・パ・ポ」／影「ポ・パ・ク・ペ」。左右で定位を変える。｜Emotion：制御不能への入り口。｜Transition：浮遊口が画面中央で大きく開き、その中へカメラが入る。
CUT06｜時間：9.0-11.2秒｜Visuals：浮遊口の内部が抽象空間になっている。これまで生まれた文字と図形が巨大化し、シュプレマティスム的な構成として空間を満たす。人物本体、影、浮遊口が別々の位置に現れ、それぞれが高速で「クパポペ！ パクポ！ ペクパ！」と発音。発音に合わせて、対応文字が一文字ずつ正確に出現し、画面内の構成がどんどん複雑になる。人物は自分が作った世界に追われるように走る。｜Camera：18mm超広角｜FPV気味に前進、左右へスラローム。｜Motion：文字生成と空間変形が高速化。人物は逃げる。｜Lighting：フラットだが図形配置で緊張感。｜VFX：強めのパララックス、図形の回転、重なり。｜SFX：3者の声が少しずつずれて重なり、中毒的なポリリズムになる。｜Emotion：最高潮。楽しいが危うい。｜Transition：人物が立ち止まり、口を閉じようとする。
CUT07｜時間：11.2-13.2秒｜Visuals：人物は中央で口を閉じ、止めようとする。しかし影と浮遊口だけがまだ動き、「ク！ パ！ ポ！ ペ！」を勝手に発音し続ける。対応する文字が人物の周囲に押し寄せ、人物は図形と文字の中に埋もれかける。人物が最後に大きく息を吸い込む。すると、画面内のすべての文字・図形・影・浮遊口が中央へ引っ張られ始める。｜Camera：32mm｜ミディアムワイド｜ゆるいドリーイン。｜Motion：前半は他要素だけが暴走、後半で吸引開始。｜Lighting：フラット。｜VFX：吸引前の静止感をしっかり見せる。｜SFX：勝手に鳴る「ク！パ！ポ！ペ！」→大きな吸気音。｜Emotion：主人公の決断。｜Transition：吸い込みをきっかけに全要素が一点へ収束。
CUT08｜時間：13.2-15.0秒｜Visuals：人物、影、浮遊口、すべての文字と図形が整然と一点に吸い込まれ、生成りホワイトの空間だけが残る。人物すら消える。0.4秒、完全な無音と空白。14.2秒で画面中央に小さく黒文字「無。」が現れる。装飾なし、平面的で静止した文字。15.0秒までそのまま保つ。｜Camera：完全固定。｜Motion：吸収後は一切動かない。｜Lighting：生成りホワイト一色。｜VFX：なしに近い。｜SFX：13.2秒以降完全無音。｜Emotion：余韻。静かなオチ。｜Transition：そのまま終了。
【音声ルール】発音と表示文字は完全一致。「ク」と言ったら必ず「ク」だけを出す。「パ」→「パ」、「ポ」→「ポ」、「ペ」→「ペ」。複合音は必ず一音ずつ分解して順番どおり表示する。例：「クパポペ」なら「ク」→「パ」→「ポ」→「ペ」の順で出現。ランダム文字の追加は禁止。
【ストーリー構造】発見（声で世界が生まれる）→遊ぶ（文字と図形で道や足場ができる）→調子に乗る（重力が壊れ、影が独立する）→暴走（口や影が勝手にしゃべる）→回収（主人公が沈黙を選ぶ）→オチ（無。）
【ビジュアルルール】ポップアートの明るすぎる原色は避ける。余白を広く使い、構図と図形配置で見せる。ベースはシュプレマティスム、異常現象はシュルレアリスム。文字はすべて物体として存在させ、床・橋・階段・空間構成要素になる。コミック的な吹き出しや派手な爆発は使わない。
【カメラルール】横顔クローズアップ→3/4上半身→真俯瞰→ダッチワイド→対面構図→口内部FPV→ミディアムワイド→完全固定。全カット同じ構図にしない。テンポは速めだが、何が起きているかは明確に見えること。

prompts.text: Create a 15-second cute, funny, educational creative animation video for kids ages 3 to 7.  Concept: Teach the letter B using the word “Butterfly” with two major visual highlights:  1. a slow, satisfying, highly engaging transformation from the word “Butterfly” into a cute butterfly 2. a slow, magical transformation from the stylized animated world into a fully realistic natural scene with a realistic butterfly  The video should feel beautiful, colorful, charming, educational, and visually mesmerizing. The transformations must not feel rushed. They should be the centerpiece of the video and should unfold clearly enough for children to enjoy and understand.  Main learning message: “B is for Butterfly.”  Visual style at the beginning: Use a premium kid-friendly animated style with soft pastel skies, rounded shapes, bright happy colors, smooth motion, clean composition, playful details, expressive design, and a light sense of humor. The early part should feel like a beautiful storybook mixed with polished modern animation.  Animation priorities: The word-to-animal transformation must be gradual, elegant, readable, and creatively staged. Children should be able to see how the letters slowly become parts of the butterfly. The stylized-to-realistic transformation must also happen gradually and beautifully, as if the animated world is blooming into real life.  Timing and scene flow:  0:00–0:02 Open on a soft dreamy pastel background with floating flowers, tiny sparkles, and gentle clouds. A large uppercase “B” appears in the center with a smaller lowercase “b” beside it. Both letters bounce softly into place with a cheerful and friendly feeling. The narrator says slowly and clearly: “B is for Butterfly.”  Hold the letters long enough for recognition.  0:02–0:04 The word “BUTTERFLY” writes itself slowly across the screen in large rounded colorful letters. Each letter fills with a different beautiful pattern, such as gradients, dots, stripes, floral shapes, and soft wing-like textures. Keep the word fully readable and centered. Let the audience admire the full word before the transformation begins.  0:04–0:09 This is the main highlight. The word “BUTTERFLY” transforms slowly and satisfyingly into the butterfly.  The transformation must be gradual, staged, and visually delicious to watch: The “B” gently opens outward and unfolds into the top wings. The “U” stretches and curves into one lower wing. The first “T” and second “T” slim down and merge into the butterfly’s long body. The “E” softens and reshapes into decorative wing markings. The “R” curls upward into one antenna. The “F” reshapes into the second antenna with a playful wobble. The “L” and “Y” arc outward and become the final wing edges and tail details.  Important: Do not transform everything at once. Let each part morph one after another in a smooth chain reaction. The letters should bend, curl, unfurl, rotate, stretch, and softly glide into their new forms. The child should still sense the original word during the transformation. Use sparkling trails, flowing color transfer, and soft elastic motion to make it deeply satisfying. The morph should feel magical, clear, and creatively intelligent.  0:09–0:11 The butterfly is now a fully formed cute stylized cartoon butterfly. It has lovely colorful wings, a tiny smiling face, big friendly eyes, and soft funny charm. It flutters gently in a playful little loop, hovers above a flower, almost sneezes from pollen in a cute funny moment, then recovers and smiles. Show the word “Butterfly” below it briefly for reinforcement. The narrator repeats: “Butterfly.”  0:11–0:14 This is the second major highlight. The entire animated scene slowly transforms into a realistic world.  The butterfly flaps its wings in slow motion. With each flap, realism increases gradually: its wing textures become more detailed the colors gain natural variation the body becomes more lifelike the flowers gain realistic petals and depth the background softens into a real sunlit garden the lighting becomes natural and golden the air gains subtle movement and realistic depth of field  This transformation should feel breathtaking, seamless, and immersive. Do not cut abruptly from cartoon to realistic. Instead, let the animated world gently bloom into reality in layers. The viewer should feel they are witnessing imagination turn into nature.  0:14–0:15 End on a beautiful realistic butterfly resting on a real flower in warm sunlight. Display the text: “B is for Butterfly” The narrator says warmly: “B is for Butterfly.” The butterfly gently flutters once, then lifts off lightly.  Style and quality requirements: Keep the letter B and the word “BUTTERFLY” clearly readable before and during transformation. Make the word-to-animal morph slow, rich, and visually rewarding. Make the stylized-to-realistic transformation equally slow, smooth, and magical. Use polished motion design, soft easing, beautiful color transitions, gentle humor, and strong visual clarity. Maintain a child-friendly tone throughout. Use clean typography, stable spelling, and seamless morphing.  Audio direction: Use cheerful, soft, magical music. Add delicate sparkles, soft pops, flutter sounds, a tiny comedic sniffle or sneeze, and a gentle emotional swell during the realism transition. Voiceover should be warm, clear, slow, and easy for children to follow.  Avoid: rushed transformations, unreadable letters, clutter, hard cuts, scary expressions, excessive camera motion, chaotic effects, or anything visually confusing for children.

prompts.text:
高品質アニメ映像。

星花魔法都市を舞台にした高級ファンタジーRPGのキャラクター導入シーン。装備設定から街への出発までを、一切途切れないゲーム内カメラで描く。表情が変わる場面は、最初に目、次に眉、続けてまぶた、口元、最後に視線の順で変化する。

【キャラクター参照】

画像1のキャラクターを全編の唯一の主人公として参照し、同一人物として維持する。

画像1は人物設計専用の参照画像とし、顔、目の形、虹彩色、瞳の特徴、髪型、髪色、前髪、衣装、装飾、武器装飾、小物、体格、シルエット、年齢感、雰囲気、キャラクターカラーのみを参照する。

画像1そのものの背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミング、文字、レイアウトは再現しない。

表情、視線、口元、姿勢、呼吸、自然な髪と衣装の揺れのみ変化してよい。

特徴の混合、顔の平均化、衣装交換、別人化、クローン化、余分な主人公の追加は禁止。

【キャラクター固定】

主人公は全編で一人のみ。

顔、髪型、衣装、装飾、小物、武器、体格、シルエット、キャラクターカラーを維持する。

武器は全編で一冊だけ存在する魔導書とし、画像1に合わせた材質・色・装飾・デザインを維持する。

開始時は左腰へ装備され、カスタマイズ時のみ左手上へ浮遊し、終了後は左腰へ戻る。

画像1に存在するアクセサリーや装飾品も維持し、不要な複製や消失は発生しない。

【画風】

劇場版品質。

高密度3Dトゥーンセルルック。

二〜三段セルシェーディング。

透明感のあるライティング。

髪、瞳、布、革、金属、宝石、紙を高密度に描き分ける。

色彩は画像1のキャラクターカラーを最優先とし、背景は人物より一段落ち着いた色調で統一する。

画風混在、リアル調、プラスチックCG、低密度背景は禁止。

【ゲームUI】

高級ファンタジーRPG風UI。

半透明クリスタルパネル。

細い金装飾。

魔法陣と星座モチーフ。

文字は読み取れる品質で安定表示。

UIは顔を覆わず画面の空き領域へ配置する。

操作に合わせて光と効果音が同期する。

【シーン】

高い俯瞰から開始。

主人公は魔法陣中央へ座り、カメラを見る。

右側へ

START NEW GAME

CONTINUE

ARCANE SETTINGS

EXIT

左上へプロフィールを表示。

CONTINUEのみ選択状態。

カーソルが一度移動して決定する。

カメラは右手へ降下。

RIGHT-HAND CATALYSTパネルが表示される。

掌の上へ六枚花弁の魔法術式が形成される。

手の形は変化せず、術式のみ再構成される。

花弁、宝石核、二重金環が完成して停止する。

続いてカメラは左手へ回り込む。

GRIMOIRE CUSTOMIZATIONを表示。

COVER

CLASP

CORE

PAGES

四項目を表示。

主人公が左手を開くと左腰から魔導書が浮遊する。

閉じた一冊の状態から、表紙、金具、中心核、ページが順番に分解される。

全パーツはルーンで接続されたまま維持される。

カーソルが四項目を巡るたび各パーツが更新され、最後に一冊へ戻る。

革、紙、金属、宝石の質感を高密度に描写する。

カメラは正面へ戻る。

CONFIRM CONFIGを表示。

主人公が一度押す。

全UIが魔導書へ吸収される。

魔導書は左腰へ戻る。

主人公は自然に座り直す。

掌の術式がゆっくり回転して完成する。

表情は目→眉→まぶた→口元→視線の順で自然に変化する。

その後カメラを少し引く。

画面下へLOADINGバー。

0%から100%まで進行する。

紫色の開始空間から石畳、建物、屋台、灯り、街路が順番に実体化する。

線画→素材→完成世界の三段階で生成される。

舞台は雨上がりの星花魔法都市。

濡れた石畳。

魔法露店。

魔法灯。

ルーン看板。

ローブ姿の群衆。

飛行する箒便。

浮遊馬車。

石造と木造建築。

遠景には巨大な魔法学院。

背景人物は全員別人であり、主人公は複製しない。

最後に三人称追従カメラになる。

主人公は中景サイズを維持する。

右上へ円形ミニマップ。

左下へ

最後は左足が石畳へ着地し、右足が次の一歩へ移る瞬間で終了する。

都市は完全に実体化し続け、群衆、箒便、浮遊馬車は動き続ける。

HUDと任務マーカーは安定表示する。

【音】

BGMなし。

音楽なし。

環境音のみ。

雨上がりの街の空気。

石畳の足音。

衣装の布擦れ。

遠い市場の声。

箒の風切り。

浮遊馬車の魔力音。

主人公は自然な呼吸のみ。

台詞、ナレーション、長い発声は禁止。

【禁止事項】

画像1の背景や構図の再現、特徴の混合、顔の平均化、衣装交換、武器変更、別人化、クローン化、余分な主人公、余分な武器、余分な装飾、手指崩れ、顔へUIが重なる構図、読めないUI文字、急激な背景転換、白飛び、画風変化は禁止。

prompts.text:
PART 1 (0–15 SECONDS)

LOCATION DETAIL: Gritty urban street at golden hour dusk. Wet concrete ground reflecting golden-orange light. Industrial concrete pillars and brick walls frame both sides. Metal railings visible. Golden-orange sky in background. Blue shadows cast across street creating high-contrast cinematic look. Volumetric dust particles floating in air catching light.

CAMERA ANGLES & CINEMATOGRAPHY:

0-1s: WIDE ESTABLISHING SHOT, camera positioned at street level, tilted slightly Dutch angle to show desperation. Slow dolly-in toward the fighter
1-3s: LOW-ANGLE CLOSE-UP on beaten fighter's face as goons surround him. Camera slightly beneath eye-level looking upward at aggressive goons (makes them look menacing, him vulnerable)
3-5s: OVERHEAD SHOT as golden-blue energy beam descends. Camera positioned directly above, looking down at the beam engulfing him
5-7s: FAST 360-DEGREE ORBITAL CAMERA ROTATION around fighter during energy explosion. Energy aura visible radiating outward. Multiple angles showing transformation from all sides
7-8s: EXTREME CLOSE-UP on fighter's face as eyes glow. Camera inches from face, eyes filling 60% of frame. Electricity crackling visible around eyes
8-9s: LOW-ANGLE UPWARD SHOT as fighter stands fully transformed. Camera positioned beneath him looking up he now TOWERS over everyone. Shows dominance shift
9-12s: DYNAMIC WHIP-PAN following first goon's charge. Camera pans rapidly to track movement, then HARD CUT to:
12-14s: SLOW-MOTION SIDE PROFILE SHOT of devastating punch. Camera positioned at exact side angle to catch punch trajectory. Slow-motion impact  shockwave visible in air, goon's body reacting to force
14-15s: TRACKING SHOT following goon flying backward. Camera moves with the goon's body trajectory, then IMPACT SHOT from goon's POV as he crashes into wall (camera shakes violently on impact)

STORY BEATS:

A beaten-down fighter in torn shirt, bruises covering his face, blood dripping, is VICIOUSLY surrounded by three aggressive goons on a wet industrial street at golden hour. He's backed against a brick wall, barely defending himself as punches rain down. He's on the verge of collapse.

SUDDENLY  a massive golden-blue energy beam EXPLODES down from the sky with CATACLYSMIC force. The beam engulfs him in blinding light. Massive ENERGY EXPLOSION  the entire street SHAKES, dust clouds ERUPT, volumetric fog fills the air.

When the light clears, he stands COMPLETELY TRANSFORMED — eyes BLAZING with godly golden-blue power, energy aura RAGING violently around his entire body with visible electricity tendrils crackling, muscles VISIBLY ENHANCED and defined, face twisted in COLD RAGE and predatory intensity.

He breathes heavily, stares at the goons with KILLING INTENT. The goons freeze in ABSOLUTE TERROR.

First goon CHARGES desperately forward. The fighter EXPLODES into motion with IMPOSSIBLE SUPERHUMAN VELOCITY. DEVASTATING PUNCH  fist CRACKS through air with SONIC intensity. SLOW-MOTION IMPACT  shockwave visible, goon's face CONTORTS in agony, blood SPRAYS, body LAUNCHES like ragdoll 20 feet backward, CRASHES through brick wall with BONE-CRUSHING force, debris ERUPTS everywhere.

PART 2 -

LOCATION DETAIL (Escalated): Same urban street, now a DEMOLITION ZONE. Concrete cracked and breaking. Brick wall partially destroyed from first impact. Metal railings BENT and snapping. Wooden crates and boxes SPLINTERED. Pillars showing cracks spreading. Golden hour light now more dramatic with darker blue shadows. Heavy dust and debris particles in air. Total DEVASTATION visible.

CAMERA ANGLES & CINEMATOGRAPHY:

15-17s: WIDE SHOT showing street arena. Camera pulls back to show scale of destruction and two remaining enemies. High-angle shot showing ground cracks
17-19s: RAPID MULTI-ANGLE FIGHT EXCHANGE alternating extreme close-ups and medium shots. Fast cutting every 0.3-0.5 seconds matching fight tempo:
Close-up on second goon's face as he launches kicks (intensity capture)
Low-angle shot of fighter's parries
High-angle overhead shot of exchange
Side profile close-up on impact moments
19-21s: MID-AIR GRAB SHOT from side angle as fighter lifts goon. Camera positioned at exact moment of lift showing superhuman strength
21-22s: VIOLENT SLAM SHOT  camera positioned ground-level looking upward as goon is SLAMMED onto concrete. IMPACT slow-motion, cracks SPREAD like spiderwebs across ground, dust ERUPTS upward
22-24s: THROW SEQUENCE  camera tracks throw trajectory. Goon FLIES through wooden crates, structures BEND and SHATTER, camera follows impact (tracking shot from side)
24-26s: INTENSE FINAL FIGHT EXCHANGE with scarred leader. Rapid multi-angle cuts showing:
Low-angle shot of fighter's punch
High-angle overhead of counter-attack
Close-up on scarred goon's face showing desperation
Metal railings BENDING in background from force
26-27s: EXTREME CLOSE-UP on fighter's fist as it CHARGES energy. Golden-blue glow INTENSIFIES, electricity CRACKLING violently around fist. Camera macro-level, glow filling entire frame
27-28s: SLOW-MOTION FINAL PUNCH setup. Camera positioned LOW-ANGLE BEHIND punch trajectory. Fist PULLS BACK with godly force visible (air distorting around fist)
28-29s: CATACLYSMIC IMPACT SLOW-MOTION. Camera positioned to capture scarred goon's face as punch connects. Eyes go WIDE in SHOCK, body CONTORTS from impact force, entire body LAUNCHED backward with EARTH-SHATTERING velocity
29-30s: PILLAR DESTRUCTION SHOT camera positioned wide to show goon CRASHES through concrete pillar like PAPER, pillar EXPLODES into massive chunks, structure COLLAPSES, debris MUSHROOMS into air, dust cloud engulfs entire area. Final frame: TIGHT CLOSE-UP on fighter's face from straight-on angle. Eyes still BLAZING with power. Breathing HEAVILY, chest HEAVING. Energy aura SLOWLY FADES. Cold MERCILESS confidence in stare. Fade to black.

STORY BEATS:

Second goon attempts RAPID KICK COMBO  fighter PARRIES with BLINDING speed. Each block CRASHES with SONIC booms. GRAB  he SLAMS goon down VIOLENTLY onto concrete, CRACKS spread like spiderwebs. THROW goon FLIES through wooden boxes, metal structures BEND and SHATTER from impact force.

Third goon  scarred leader, last hope  steps forward DESPERATELY. This is BRUTAL WARFARE. EXPLOSIVE hand-to-hand combat: PUNCH blocked, COUNTERATTACK devastating, SPINNING KICK with BONE-BREAKING force, GRAPPLE with SUPERHUMAN pressure. Ground SHATTERS beneath them. Metal railings BEND and SNAP. Every collision sends SHOCKWAVES across street.

FINAL MOMENT  fighter CHARGES energy into fist. Fist GLOWS BLINDING GOLD-BLUE. Pulls back with GODLY FORCE. Unleashes CATACLYSMIC POWERED PUNCH.

SLOW-MOTION IMPACT  scarred goon's body CONTORTS, eyes WIDE in SHOCK, LAUNCHED backward with EARTH-SHATTERING velocity, CRASHES THROUGH concrete pillar like PAPER, pillar EXPLODES into massive chunks, entire structure COLLAPSES, dust MUSHROOMS into air.

Fighter stands alone in TOTAL DEVASTATION. Breathing HEAVILY, chest HEAVING, eyes still BLAZING. Energy aura SLOWLY FADES. Stares DIRECTLY at camera with COLD MERCILESS confidence.
